Sam (People Ops): Quick Q: manager submitted an exception request to move an IC from L3 -> L4 outside of regular cycle. Effective date requested 2026-03-15. What docs do we need to finalize payroll/equity and make sure comp team signs off?
Aisha (Engineering Manager): Submitted rationale + 3 peer benchmarks in the form. Also attached 1:1 notes and recent hiring band for L4. Need clarity on equity grant treatment since promotion happened mid-quarter.
Erin (Comp): Hi! For exceptions we need: (1) completed exception form ID, (2) three comp benchmarks w/ roles/companies, (3) manager calibration note, (4) approval ticket from comp committee (CC-EX-2026-03-29). For payroll/equity mapping add Workday change ID.
Sam (People Ops): Thanks Erin. If promotion is backdated to 2026-03-15 but we approved 2026-03-29, will base pay be retro? Manager worried about two paychecks showing different gross amounts.
Erin (Comp): Standard practice: base pay retro to effective date when approved after cutoff. Payroll will issue a single retro payment line on the next available payroll posting. We require the eff_date field in the change payload. Communicate clearly to the employee to avoid confusion.
Aisha (Engineering Manager): Equity note: do we pro-rate RSU tranche or issue a separate PRORATE grant?
Erin (Comp): Two options: (A) pro-rate the standard refresh for remainder of cycle and apply as separate line item labeled `PRORATE_REFRESH` in Workday; or (B) grant an off-cycle one-time RSU labeled `OFFCYCLE_REFRESH`. Comp prefers A for simplicity except when market correction warrants B. Either way include vesting start date in the payload.
Comp-approvals-bot: Approval recorded: CC-EX-2026-03-29 approved by comp@redwood.com. Ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CC-EX-2026-03-29
Sam (People Ops): Perfect. Anything else for payroll file? Format/sample?
Erin (Comp): Payroll needs CSV columns: employee_id, name, old_salary, new_salary, eff_date, exception_ticket, comp_approver, equity_action. Example:
```
67890,Aisha Khan,110000,125000,2026-03-15,CC-EX-2026-03-29,Erin M,"PRORATE_REFRESH: 0.75"
```
Sam (People Ops): Got it. And retro timing?
Comp-approvals-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff for March was 2026-03-31 23:59 PT. Retro adjustments will post with payroll on 2026-04-15.
Aisha (Engineering Manager): Thanks all. I'll upload the exception packet and the CSV once Erin confirms the ticket ID is attached. I'll also draft comms saying: "You'll see a retro adjustment in mid-April."
Erin (Comp): Sounds good. If manager prefers no retro, comp must approve explicit note and employee must sign acknowledgement.
Sam (People Ops): Closing loop: I'll create the Workday change task and paste ID here when done. :white_check_mark:
